expected_result: Cart state syncs correctly, no race conditions, last valid action wins or merge logic applied

title: Verify site validates and sanitizes all user inputs to prevent XSS
precondition: User enters script in input fields
steps: Enter <script>alert('xss')</script> in search, review, address fields
expected_result: Input sanitized/escaped, script not executed, stored/displayed as plain text, no XSS vulnerability

title: Verify site handles extremely long input values without breaking
steps: Paste 10,000 character string in name/address field
expected_result: Backend truncates or rejects with validation error, frontend has maxlength attribute, no server error/500

title: Verify site handles special characters in user input correctly
steps: Enter names/addresses with emojis, accented chars, symbols: José ?? Müller & Co.
expected_result: Data stored and displayed correctly, no encoding issues, search/filter works with special characters

title: Verify site handles timezone differences for order dates/times
precondition: User in different timezone than server
steps: Place order at 11 PM local time
expected_result: Dates/times displayed in user's local timezone (or clearly labeled), no confusion about order timing

title: Verify site handles daylight saving time transitions correctly
steps: Place order during DST transition hour
expected_result: System handles ambiguous/nonexistent times correctly, logs use UTC, display converts properly to local time

title: Verify site prevents price manipulation via client-side edits
steps: Use browser dev tools to change product price HTML to $0.01
expected_result: Backend validates price against database, charges correct price, ignores client-side tampering, logs attempt

title: Verify site prevents adding more inventory than available
steps: Try to add quantity 10 to cart
expected_result: Frontend limits quantity selector to available stock, backend validates on add-to-cart and checkout, blocks overage

title: Verify site handles concurrent purchases of last item correctly
precondition: Two users buy last item simultaneously
steps: User A and B both have last item in cart
expected_result: First user succeeds, second user gets "Item no longer available" error at checkout, inventory never goes negative

title: Verify site handles payment gateway downtime gracefully
expected_result: User sees friendly message "Payment service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later." with retry option, order not created

title: Verify site logs errors securely without exposing sensitive data
expected_result: Logs contain error context but NOT: passwords, full card numbers, PII; uses log levels, structured logging

title: Verify site rate-limits abusive requests to prevent DoS
steps: Script sends 100 requests/second to product API
expected_result: After threshold, returns 429 Too Many Requests, implements exponential backoff suggestion, protects backend

title: Verify site handles corrupted or malformed cookie data
steps: Manually edit cookie to invalid JSON/value
expected_result: System detects invalid session, clears bad cookie, redirects to login or starts new guest session, no crash

title: Verify site handles browser back button during checkout appropriately
precondition: User navigates back in checkout flow
expected_result: Either: stays on current step with warning, or returns to previous step with data preserved, no data loss or duplicate submission

title: Verify site handles copy-paste of formatted text into inputs
expected_result: System strips formatting, keeps plain text only, no HTML/CSS injected, displays correctly

title: Verify site provides clear contact/support options when errors occur
expected_result: Page shows: friendly error message, reference ID for support, link to Help Center, email/chat contact option

title: Verify homepage loads in under 2 seconds on fast 4G
expected_result: First Contentful Paint <1.8s, Largest Contentful Paint <2.5s, passes Core Web Vitals thresholds

title: Verify product images are optimized and lazy-loaded
expected_result: Images load only when near viewport (lazy-load), served in modern format (WebP/AVIF), responsive sizes via srcset

title: Verify critical CSS is inlined for above-fold content
expected_result: Critical styles inlined in <style> tag, non-critical CSS loaded async, no render-blocking resources above fold

title: Verify JavaScript bundles are code-split and lazy-loaded
steps: Check Network tab for JS files
expected_result: Initial load only loads essential JS, checkout-specific code loaded only when needed, reduces initial bundle size

title: Verify site uses browser caching effectively for static assets
expected_result: Images, CSS, JS have long cache TTL (1 year), versioned filenames, reload uses cache, 304 Not Modified responses

title: Verify site implements Content Security Policy (CSP) headers
expected_result: CSP header present with strict-dynamic, nonce for inline scripts, blocks unsafe-eval, reports violations

title: Verify site uses HTTPS exclusively with HSTS enabled
expected_result: HTTP redirects to HTTPS automatically, HSTS header with long max-age, preload directive if applicable

title: Verify site protects against common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10)
expected_result: No SQL injection, XSS, CSRF vulnerabilities found; proper input validation, output encoding, CSRF tokens

title: Verify user passwords are hashed securely in backend
expected_result: Passwords stored as bcrypt/Argon2 hashes with salt, never plaintext or weak MD5/SHA1, hashing params logged securely

title: Verify site implements proper session management
expected_result: Session cookie has Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict flags, session ID regenerated on login, timeout enforced

title: Verify API endpoints require authentication for protected resources
expected_result: Unauthenticated requests return 401 Unauthorized, authenticated requests with valid token return data, scope enforced

title: Verify site rate-limits login attempts to prevent brute force
steps: Script attempts 20 login tries with wrong passwords
expected_result: After 5-10 failures, returns 429 or introduces delay, locks account temporarily, logs suspicious activity

title: Verify site sanitizes file uploads to prevent malicious files
steps: Try to upload .php/.exe file as avatar
expected_result: System rejects non-image extensions, validates MIME type server-side, scans for malware, stores outside web root

title: Verify site uses parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection
expected_result: All queries use prepared statements/ORM parameterization, no string concatenation with user input, input validated

title: Verify site implements proper CORS configuration for APIs
steps: Check CORS headers on API responses
Test cross-origin requests from malicious domain
expected_result: CORS allows only trusted origins, not wildcard *, credentials handled securely, preflight requests work correctly

title: Verify site logs security events for monitoring and audit
expected_result: Logs capture: timestamp, user/IP, action, result; sent to SIEM, retained per policy, alerting on anomalies

title: Verify site dependencies are scanned for known vulnerabilities
expected_result: No critical/high CVEs in dependencies, automated PRs for updates, pinned versions, regular dependency reviews

title: Verify site has a documented security incident response plan
expected_result: Plan exists with: roles, communication steps, containment procedures, legal/compliance contacts, post-mortem process

title: Verify site undergoes regular security testing and penetration tests
expected_result: Annual third-party penetration tests, quarterly vulnerability scans, bug bounty program, findings tracked to resolution

title: Verify site complies with data privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA)
steps: Review cookie consent, data export/delete flows
expected_result: Clear cookie consent banner, easy data access/deletion requests, data minimization, privacy policy updated, DPO contact

title: Verify site is fully responsive on mobile viewports (320px-414px)
expected_result: Content reflows correctly, no horizontal scroll, touch targets adequate, fonts readable, images scale

title: Verify mobile navigation menu is accessible and usable
expected_result: Menu opens smoothly, categories expandable, back button works, close/X visible, keyboard doesn't obstruct

title: Verify product images are tappable and zoomable on mobile
expected_result: Image opens in lightbox, swipe gestures work, pinch zoom functional or double-tap to zoom, close button easy to tap

title: Verify mobile checkout form inputs trigger correct keyboards
expected_result: Email: shows @ keyboard, Card: numeric keypad, Expiry: MM/YY picker or numeric, improves data entry speed

title: Verify mobile site avoids horizontal scrolling in content areas
expected_result: No unintended horizontal scroll, content fits viewport width, carousels swipe horizontally intentionally

title: Verify mobile buttons and CTAs are easily tappable (min 44px)
steps: Attempt to tap Add to Cart, Checkout buttons
expected_result: All primary buttons have minimum 44x44px touch area, adequate spacing between interactive elements

title: Verify mobile site loads efficiently on 3G networks
expected_result: Critical content loads in <5s, images lazy-load, non-essential JS deferred, perceived performance acceptable

title: Verify mobile site handles orientation changes gracefully
expected_result: Layout adapts smoothly, no content cutoff, images reflow, form inputs remain usable, no JS errors

title: Verify mobile search is optimized for thumb-friendly use
expected_result: Search bar expands to full width, keyboard appears with search action button, suggestions easy to tap

title: Verify mobile cart drawer is accessible and doesn't block content
expected_result: Drawer slides up/in without covering critical info, close button prominent, scrollable if many items

title: Verify mobile product variant selectors are easy to use
steps: Tap size/color selectors on product page
expected_result: Selectors use native pickers or large tap targets, selected state clear, updates price/inventory visibly

title: Verify mobile checkout flow minimizes steps and typing
expected_result: Autofill enabled, address lookup, saved payment methods, minimal required fields, progress indicator clear

title: Verify mobile site supports browser autofill for forms
expected_result: Browser suggests saved info, user can select to auto-fill fields, works for contact, shipping, payment

title: Verify mobile site handles virtual keyboard overlay correctly
steps: Observe page behavior with keyboard open
expected_result: Page scrolls to keep focused input visible, doesn't hide submit button, layout adjusts for keyboard height

title: Verify mobile site provides clear feedback for touch interactions
expected_result: Visual feedback on tap (ripple, color change), haptic feedback if supported, confirms action registration

title: Verify mobile site avoids hover-dependent interactions
steps: Try to access hover menus on mobile
expected_result: No critical functionality requires hover; menus use tap-to-open, tooltips accessible via tap or always visible

title: Verify mobile site loads web fonts efficiently without FOIT/FOUT
expected_result: Uses font-display: swap, critical text in system font fallback, no invisible text flash, fonts load quickly

title: Verify mobile site respects user preferences for reduced motion
steps: Set OS preference to reduce motion
expected_result: Animations disabled or simplified, no auto-scrolling carousels, transitions respect user setting

title: Verify mobile site provides easy way to return to top of long pages
expected_result: Floating scroll-to-top button appears after scrolling, or sticky header with link, one-tap to return

title: Verify mobile site handles poor connectivity with offline support (basic)
expected_result: Previously visited pages load from cache, clear message when content unavailable, retry option when back online
